games.note: Denver totals row (fg 26-49, ft 19-27, reb 29, pf 17, pts 71) matches player sum exactly as printed. New Mexico totals row (fg 28-70, ft 10-13, reb 38, pf 25, pts 66) also matches, but two individual cells were ambiguous on the scan: Ben Monroe's printed 'Total Points' cell looked like 25 while his fg/ft line (10-24 fg, 3-4 ft) computes to 23; Ron Sanford's fg-made digit looked like 2 but his printed points (4) with ft 2-2 only computes if fg-made=1. Both were resolved to the values that make the team FGM/FTM/points totals row balance exactly (28 FGM, 10 FTM, 66 pts), which is the most reliable disambiguation available without a higher-resolution scan; used pts=23 for Monroe and fg=1-5 for Sanford accordingly. Ron Nelson's reb/pf cells (2, 3) were faint and read with lower confidence, but do not affect the checksum.
